name: tersign
description: Official Tersign plugin — counter-signed evidence for agent commerce. Verify a counterparty's receipts and evidence bundles offline with no account, and put your own agent's actions on a neutral, independently verifiable record.

plugins.name: tersign
plugins.description: Counter-signed evidence for agent commerce. Verify a counterparty's x402 receipt file, or an evidence bundle with the action records in it, OFFLINE with no account and no API key; record disclosures into a neutral hash-chained ledger anchored to Bitcoin with no configuration (the first call self-provisions a signer-keyed account, and this plugin collects no key); issue counter-signed receipts from a configured seller account; fetch a dispute-ready envelope for the venue that will hear it.
